text:
Lee: heads up — seeing a burst of duplicate SSE chunks when a customer's client hops between edge proxies. console shows the session routed to old proxy for ~6s after reconnect.
Sam: ugh. do you have request ids?
Lee: sample: req=rc_32f9, session=ss_98a, client region=eu-west; duplicates manifest as repeated chat.delta events.
Mia: logs from proxy-12 show a tombstone entry for session ss_98a with ttl=0 and lease_version=2. new proxy picks up lease_version=3 but resume still tries to read from tombstone -> 404 then fallback to fresh stream.
Jordan: console telemetry shows two streams counted for that session for ~7s, billing doubled. dashboard trace attached shows sticky-route switched but console route map stale. :face_with_monocle:
Sam: probably race between tombstone gc and lease bump. we never surface lease_version in the resume protocol, only session id & resume_token.
Lee: right — proposed quick fix: include `X-Session-Lease-Version` header in resume and stream responses so proxies can assert monotonic lease. if mismatch return 409 instead of 404 and trigger idempotent dedupe in runtime.
Mia: 409 would make the console and router converge faster. also suggest we add tombstone metadata to `session-state` cache (last-proxy, lease-version, tombstone-ts).
Sam: repro steps: 1) open stream on proxy A 2) force route claim on proxy B (simulate network flake) 3) proxy A writes tombstone with lease_version++ and small grace ttl 4) client reconnects to B and server issues resume. current path: B sees tombstone key, treats as missing -> open new stream. resulting dup payloads until A tombstone fully removed from downstream.
Jordan: UX/console impact: we should show a little badge when session route mismatch detected and surface `lease_version` in session inspector. ops can then correlate to billing spikes.
Lee: short-term mitigation: increase tombstone propagation (gossip) and add a metric: `session.tombstone.mismatch` to trigger alerts when >1/min.
Sam: I'll prototype header change and 409 semantics. can we ship opt-in via feature-flag on edge for a Canary tenant?
Mia: yes, we can gate it. deploy-bot: rolling canary flag "lease-version-resume" enabled for tenant=canary-42 at 2026-03-20T18:22:00Z.
Jordan: once Sam has prototype, I'll wire console inspector to fetch lease_version and show counts.
Lee: thanks — file a tiny RFC? brief design + rollback plan. keep it minimal.
Sam: will do, assigning to self.
Lee: cool. leaving a note: watch for duplicate billing alerts while canary is on.
